uncertain_points.claim: The mux3_sel_e enum defines only 3 of 32 possible 5-bit encodings; an unexpected value on a signal of this type could cause undefined mux output behavior.
uncertain_points.cond: When a signal declared as mux3_sel_e receives an encoding other than MUX3_SEL_0, MUX3_SEL_1, or MUX3_SEL_2 (e.g., due to reset, glitch, or uninitialized state).
uncertain_points.risk: Undefined mux output may propagate corrupt or sensitive data, potentially leading to cryptographic fault or key exposure.
